summary: Update internal support tooling/runbooks with data residency dashboards + audit event queries
description:
Request from Support Readiness to update internal tooling/runbooks so on-call Support and SRE can quickly:

1) Identify whether a spike in residency-related errors is due to customer misconfiguration vs platform routing/policy evaluator.
2) Locate the correct Grafana panels and Prometheus queries for residency enforcement.
3) Pull audit event examples/queries for residency allow/deny decisions and violations to support GRC evidence requests.

Background:
- During early beta enablement, Support is seeing new denial errors (e.g., RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH) and needs fast triage paths.
- Security/GRC is receiving requests for audit payload samples and proof of enforcement decisions.

Scope (internal-only):
- Add a dedicated section to the existing Support runbook for residency enforcement with links to dashboards and common queries.
- Provide copy-pastable queries for:
  - Violation rate by org/project/region
  - Policy evaluator health (latency/errors/cache)
  - Router fallback counters (should be zero when pinned unless exception)
  - Audit events: residency.policy_evaluated and residency.violation
- Document how to correlate:
  - API request_id / trace_id
  - org_id / project_id
  - evaluated_region vs requested_region vs routed_region
  - decision_reason and policy source (org vs project)

Out of scope:
- Changing metrics definitions or adding new metrics (tracked in Eng initiatives/PRs).

Acceptance criteria:
- Runbook section exists and is linked from Support escalation playbook.
- At least 3 Grafana panels are called out with direct links and what to look for.
- Audit event query examples included for both the internal audit log UI and SIEM export (Splunk/Sentinel style).
- Verified by Support lead (Dev Patel) and SRE (Rafael Mendes) that the steps are usable during an incident.
comments: 2025-01-21 10:14 Dev Patel: Creating internal ticket based on Support feedback from EU beta accounts. We need a single place to point folks for residency dashboards + audit event queries. Recent examples: SUP-3988 (mis-targeted US endpoint) and SUP-4077 (audit payload samples).

resolution: Runbook and internal tooling references updated to include residency enforcement dashboards, key PromQL queries, and audit event search templates. Added correlation guidance (request_id/trace_id/org_id) and evidence-friendly audit payload fields per GRC. Support and SRE reviewers confirmed usability during beta escalation scenarios.
